commit.message: Polish app visuals and social card

Add STFU menu bar to main app

Reimplements the menu bar app design proposed by Greg Ceccarelli in gregce/stfu#1, adapted to the current STFU codebase and shared action model.

Keeps the menu bar surface inside STFU.app so the full window and menu item share one macOS Accessibility and Automation identity. Removes the old separate STFU Menu.app packaging path while preserving quiet refreshes, inline confirmations, documentation, screenshots, and focused menu-bar tests.

Co-authored-by: Greg Ceccarelli <gregce@gmail.com>

Avoid generic speaker false positives

Do not treat arbitrary page text containing speaker as an audible browser indicator. Chrome exposes stronger labels such as Audio playing and Mute tab for actual audible tabs, and the regression test covers ordinary content text.

Confirm browser activation before tab close

Use Accessibility to request the target browser app become frontmost before posting Command-W. This fixes the installed E2E path where Chrome reported a tab close but left the audible tab open when normal activation was not enough.

Move build docs out of README

Keeps the README focused on install, permissions, and usage while moving local build, packaging, release, and notarization instructions into DEVELOPMENT.md.

Polish macOS app presentation

Refines the STFU app chrome around the Samuel banner with a warmer native dark palette, rounded list surface, custom row backgrounds, calmer typography, less saturated controls, and more balanced spacing.

Harden Swift app action safety

Applies the expert Swift/macOS review pass: remove MainActor assumeIsolated from launch, skip stale CoreAudio objects, defensively type-check focused AX windows, verify frontmost app/window before global Cmd-W, move UI focus/close actions off the main actor, revalidate app audio sources before termination, and make close-all handle tab renumbering and failed closes safely.

Co-authored-by: Greg Ceccarelli <gregce@gmail.com>

Add targeted Chromium safety regression tests

Adds pure tests for tab title cleanup and Chromium tab identity selection, including wrong-index, ambiguous-title, and single-nonmatching-tab cases so row actions keep failing closed after rescans.

Co-authored-by: Greg Ceccarelli <gregce@gmail.com>

Harden STFU structure and release checks

Implements the PR #1 hardening direction: move reusable code into STFULib, keep the executable entrypoint tiny, add pure Swift behavior tests, make browser row actions resolve value snapshots at action time, stabilize close-all identity, and tighten verify/release packaging ergonomics.

Co-authored-by: Greg Ceccarelli <gregce@gmail.com>
